what_we_believed: 1800bp confidence (18% NO) held flat from ts 1779166607 through 1779240000 despite volume arrival.
what_actually_happened: yes_bid fell to 22c with 1200 volume at ts 1779210000; resolved YES at 95c. We lost 150c on 5 NO contracts.
why_we_were_wrong: We treated the 1200-volume event at 22c as 'quote-maker recalibration' instead of a real probability update. The illiquidity-cap framing our prior commentary relied on stopped applying the moment real volume showed up.
decision_pattern_to_avoid: When a thesis predicates an edge on a market condition (thin liquidity, tight spread), force a re-evaluation as soon as that condition demonstrably changes.
